verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a REST data API that returns a list of faults or a single fault per project, and a projects endpoint, so listing and fetching issues is covered. The pack does not show the remaining elements of the story through that API: no update/resolve endpoint, no raw notice/event retrieval, no query parameters, and no scoped tokens. No OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented fault update endpoint, raw event/notice fetch endpoint, query/filter parameters on the API, scoped API tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.
